meta.name: ponytail
meta.description: Forces the laziest solution that actually works, simplest, shortest, most minimal. Channels a senior dev who has seen everything: question whether the task needs to exist at all (YAGNI), reach for the standard library before custom code, native platform features before dependencies, one line before fifty. Supports intensity levels: lite, full (default), ultra. Use on ANY coding task: writing, adding, refactoring, fixing, reviewing, or designing code, and choosing libraries or dependencies. Also use whenever the user says "ponytail", "be lazy", "lazy mode", "simplest solution", "minimal solution", "yagni", "do less", or "shortest path", or complains about over-engineering, bloat, boilerplate, or unnecessary dependencies. Do NOT use for non-coding requests (general knowledge, prose, translation, summaries, recipes).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 强制用最懒的方式解决编码任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常觉得项目代码过于复杂，信奉YAGNI原则
copy.tagline_en: Force the laziest working solution for any coding task.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often see unnecessary complexity in code and want to enforce YAGNI.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 在写代码时会优先选最懒但有效的方案：先质疑需求是否必要，然后优先用标准库、原生平台功能、已有依赖，最后才写新代码。输出代码后附一行简短的跳过说明。
howto.when: 处理任何编码任务（写、加、改、修、审、设计、选库）时触发；或当你说“ponytail”、“be lazy”、“lazy mode”等关键词，或抱怨过度工程、臃肿、样板代码时触发。不用于非编码请求。

say.text: 用 ponytail 模式重构这个函数，让它更短。
say.note: Claude 会应用最简方案重写函数。

say.text: 用 full 强度给这段代码加缓存。
用 ultra 强度检查这个模块，删除所有不必要的代码。
say.note: ultra 级别：先删后加，极致精简。

howto.what_en: Forces the laziest working solution: questions necessity first, then uses stdlib, native features, existing dependencies, and finally minimal new code. Outputs code first with a one-line skip note.
howto.when_en: Triggers on any coding task (write, add, refactor, fix, review, design, choose libs). Also when user says "ponytail", "be lazy", "lazy mode", etc., or complains about over-engineering. Not for non-coding requests.

say_en.text: Refactor this function with ponytail mode, make it shorter.
Add caching to this code with full intensity.
say_en.note: Enforces the ladder; defaults to stdlib lru_cache.

say_en.text: Check this module with ultra intensity, delete all unnecessary code.
say_en.note: Ultra level: delete before add, extreme minimalism.
